lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Xièxie! Nǐ lái le, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
lines.en: Thank you! I'm happy you came.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ sòng nǐ de.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 谢谢你！我们一起吃西瓜吧。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ! Wǒmen yīqǐ chī xīguā ba.
lines.en: Thank you! Let's have some watermelon together.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 好！有面条吗？我很喜欢吃面条。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo! Yǒu miàntiáo ma? Wǒ hěn xǐhuan chī miàntiáo.
lines.en: OK! Is there noodles? I really like noodles.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Yǒu, hái yǒu hěn duō shuǐguǒ.
lines.en: Yes, and there is plenty of fruit too.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 他们在房间里唱歌跳舞。
lines.pinyin: Tāmen zài fángjiān li chànggē tiàowǔ.
lines.en: They are singing and dancing in the room.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Zhēn hǎo! Wǒ yě yào chànggē.
lines.en: Nice! I want to sing too.
